description:
Grants you and your tethered elemental an effect based on its active element.

Fire: Increases critical strike chance and hit chance for you and your elemental by $420100s1%.

Water: Increases healing done for you and your elemental and reduces the mana cost of all spells by $420110s1%.

Air: Increases haste for you and your elemental and reduces magical damage taken by $420120s1%.

Earth: Reduces damage taken by you and your elemental by $420130s1% and increases Stamina by $420130s1%.

Other Elementals: Increases all damage done by $420140s1% and decreases all damage taken by $420140s1%.
